provenance.note: quote = every row's logic_version carries oddsobs=quote (A3-era compute with the race's win-quote provenance); proxy = oddsobs=proxy (fallback to race_horses.updated_at) or no token (pre-A3 compute). Days with any proxy race are dry_run. races.win_odds_observed_at is not used for this (overwritten by the final-odds write once results land).

inputs.feature_builder: horseracing_training.market_ev.load_rows/build_features (as-of) + r02_drift.market_block on odds_used; weather/going = current DB values (D9)

ens15_parity_vs_stored_win_prob.note: stored win_prob was computed on the same odds_used; residual differences come from as-of inputs that moved since compute (weather/going current values, D9)

bootstrap.method: race-day block bootstrap, shared draws across arms/series

rules.threshold: no verdict until >= 8 eligible (non-dry-run) race days AND >= 200 eligible races; below that verdict='recorded_only'
rules.i: judged arm only: closing-odds 2026 OOS (<= 2026-06-26) NLL <= ens15 + 0.0002 and race-normalised winner NLL not worse (checked separately, T012)
rules.ii: paired difference in nll_J vs ens15: 95% interval upper bound < 0
rules.iii: EV_J>1.0 band sum won / sum p_hat closer to 1 than ens15 (direction only while hits are few)
